basic_details.job_title: DAMO Dhanbad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 Yoga Instructor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Yoga Instructors with a degree, diploma or certificate in Yoga, or Yoga Certification Board / Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana certification, can apply for 12 posts (11 male, 1 female) at Rs. 250 per yoga session under the Office of the District AYUSH Medical Officer (Zila AYUSH Chikitsa Padadhikari), Dhanbad, Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department, Jharkhand. The Yoga Instructors (Yog Prashikshak) will run sessions at Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) centres and the District Combined Dispensary under the Dhanbad District AYUSH Samiti. how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form (Vihit Prapatra) from the office notice board or the NIC Dhanbad Portal, https://dhanbad.nic.in. The form is also printed with the notice, along with the list of centres.
Fill in the name, father's or husband's name, date of birth (as per the matriculation certificate), mobile number, email, permanent address and correspondence address.
Enter the educational qualifications from Class 10 to the highest, and work experience if any (post, office/institution, from and to dates).
Choose three Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) workplaces in order of preference in the form; this is mandatory.
Paste a self-attested passport-size photograph, attach self-attested certificates and mark sheets of all qualifications, and sign the declaration with date and place.
Submit the application in hard copy at the office of the District Combined Dispensary, Dhanbad, and by email to [email protected] between 26 November 2026 and 10 December 2026, 05:00 PM.
Documents named in the notice and form:
Self-attested certificates and mark sheets of all qualifications (with the form)
Self-attested passport-size photograph (pasted on the form)
At the interview: two self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates
At the interview: two passport-size photographs

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office
content_sections.text: The Office of the District AYUSH Medical Officer, Dhanbad works under the Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department and is located near Sadar Hospital, Dhanbad, Jharkhand - 826001. The press release (Press Vigyapti) fills Yoga Instructor positions for the Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) centres and the District Combined Dispensary run under the Dhanbad District AYUSH Samiti. The instructors conduct yoga and other wellness activities at these centres.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 12 Yoga Instructor positions: 11 for male instructors and 1 for a female instructor. The centre-wise list attached to the notice is reproduced below. The only position for a female Yoga Instructor is at the District Combined Dispensary (Homoeopathic), Sadar Dhanbad. The notice gives no category-wise reservation break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification printed in the notice for the Yoga Instructor (Male/Female) post is: Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Yoga from a recognised University/Institution, or Yoga Certification Board / Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana certified Yoga Instructor. The application form asks candidates to list their qualifications from Class 10 upward to the highest, with year of passing, board or university, marks and percentage, and to give work experience if any. Work experience is not listed as an essential condition. Yoga Instructors living within a 05 to 10 km radius of the Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) / Health and Wellness Centre / Government AYUSH Dispensary and the District Combined Dispensary will be given priority. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A Yoga Instructor is paid Rs. 250/- for each session. The engagement is on a remuneration basis, and working days and yoga sessions will follow the guidelines of the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India. The number of sessions at each Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) is fixed as follows: Each session lasts two hours and must be held on the fixed date and time. The notice does not state the period over which these sessions are counted. No claim regarding regularisation of the job after appointment will be considered, and a candidate who claims regularisation in future will have the candidature ended.

content_sections.heading: Dhanbad AYUSH Yoga Instructor Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct yoga and other Wellness Activities at the allotted Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) or District Combined Dispensary. Hold the required number of two-hour yoga sessions on the fixed date and time. Sessions take place at a marked place in the Ayushman Arogya Mandir; when no space is available there, a place may be fixed in the nearest school, panchayat bhawan, anganwadi centre or other community building.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dhanbad AYUSH Yoga Instructor
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form (Vihit Prapatra) from the office notice board or the NIC Dhanbad Portal, https://dhanbad.nic.in . The form is also printed with the notice, along with the list of centres. Fill in the name, father's or husband's name, date of birth (as per the matriculation certificate), mobile number, email, permanent address and correspondence address. Enter the educational qualifications from Class 10 to the highest, and work experience if any (post, office/institution, from and to dates). Choose three Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) workplaces in order of preference in the form; this is mandatory. Paste a self-attested passport-size photograph, attach self-attested certificates and mark sheets of all qualifications, and sign the declaration with date and place. Submit the application in hard copy at the office of the District Combined Dispensary, Dhanbad, and by email to [email protected] between 26 November 2026 and 10 December 2026, 05:00 PM. Documents named in the notice and form: Self-attested certificates and mark sheets of all qualifications (with the form) Self-attested passport-size photograph (pasted on the form) At the interview: two self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates At the interview: original certificates At the interview: two passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview, which it also calls a Walk-In Interview, but the interview date, time and venue are not specified in the notice. If more than one candidate is selected, the marks obtained in the yoga course will be the second deciding factor. Instructors living within 05 to 10 km of the centre get priority. No travelling allowance is payable for attending the interview. The District Selection Committee reserves the right to change the Walk-In Interview date as needed.

faq.question: Q1. How many Yoga Instructor vacancies are there in Dhanbad AYUSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 Yoga Instructor positions: 11 for male and 1 for female instructors.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Dhanbad Yoga Instructor posts?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 26 November 2026 to 10 December 2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Dhanbad AYUSH Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: A Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Yoga from a recognised University/Institution, or Yoga Certification Board / Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana certification as a Yoga Instructor.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Dhanbad AYUSH Yoga Instructor?
faq.answer: A Yoga Instructor is paid Rs. 250/- per session; each session lasts two hours.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Dhanbad Yoga Instructor posts?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed form in hard copy at the office of the District Combined Dispensary, Dhanbad, and by email to [email protected] by 10 December 2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. How will Yoga Instructors be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview; if more than one candidate is selected, the marks in the yoga course are the second deciding factor, and instructors living within 05 to 10 km of the centre get priority.

faq.question: Q7. How many sessions does a Yoga Instructor have to conduct?
faq.answer: Male instructors must conduct a minimum of 10 and a maximum of 32 sessions, and female instructors a minimum of 10 and a maximum of 20 sessions, at each Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH).

faq.question: Q8. Is the Dhanbad Yoga Instructor job permanent?
faq.answer: No claim regarding regularisation after appointment will be considered; the engagement is on a per-session remuneration basis.

faq.question: Q9. Can I choose my place of posting?
faq.answer: Yes, the application form requires candidates to choose three Ayushman Arogya Mandir (AYUSH) workplaces in order of preference.

faq.question: Q10. Is travelling allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, no travelling allowance is payable for attending the interview.
